uso: Closed wordlist of generic tags for the Jev Classifier 'Generate topic tags' command, English version (same structure as taxonomia-tags.json). Jev only picks tags from this list.

regras.formato: lowercase, no accents, kebab-case, no '/' (flat tags)
regras.nao_usar: directory tags (project/, concept/, tool/, reference/...) and proper names; specific people, courses and projects go in links, not tags
regras.adicionar_tag: only when it shows up in 3+ notes and fits no existing tag
